history.created_by: RUN /bin/sh -c apk update && apk upgrade     &&     apk add         fts         libstdc++         tini         tzdata         json-c         libbz2         libcurl         libmilter         libxml2         ncurses-libs         pcre2         zlib     &&     rm -rf /var/cache/apk/* &&     addgroup -S "clamav" &&     adduser -D -G "clamav" -h "/var/lib/clamav" -s "/bin/false" -u 100 -S "clamav" &&     install -d -m 755 -g "clamav" -o "clamav" "/var/log/clamav" &&     chown -R clamav:clamav /var/lib/clamav # buildkit
RUN /bin/sh -c freshclam --foreground --stdout || true &&     rm -f /var/lib/clamav/freshclam.dat /var/lib/clamav/mirrors.dat || true # buildkit

RUN /bin/sh -c apk add --no-cache --upgrade 'pcre2=10.49-r0' 'zlib=1.3.2-r1' 'nghttp2-libs=1.70.0-r0' 'musl=1.2.6-r3' 'musl-utils=1.2.6-r3' 'brotli-libs=1.2.1-r0'  && test "$(apk info -v 2>/dev/null | grep '^musl-[0-9]')" = 'musl-1.2.6-r3'  && test "$(apk info -v 2>/dev/null | grep '^musl-utils-[0-9]')" = 'musl-utils-1.2.6-r3'  && test "$(apk info -v 2>/dev/null | grep '^pcre2-[0-9]')" = 'pcre2-10.49-r0'  && test "$(apk info -v 2>/dev/null | grep '^zlib-[0-9]')" = 'zlib-1.3.2-r1'  && test "$(apk info -v 2>/dev/null | grep '^nghttp2-libs-[0-9]')" = 'nghttp2-libs-1.70.0-r0'  && test "$(apk info -v 2>/dev/null | grep '^brotli-libs-[0-9]')" = 'brotli-libs-1.2.1-r0'  && apk add --no-cache 'libcurl=8.23.0-r0'  && test "$(apk info -v 2>/dev/null | grep '^libcurl-[0-9]')" = 'libcurl-8.23.0-r0'  && rm -rf /var/log/apk.log /var/cache/apk/* # buildkit
